parsed.post: Discarded MATRIX_LR=0.03 (1.0085 vs 1.0054). It seems the lower LR trend is not universally beneficial when combined with different warmup ratios. Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.03 (current best) and following the consensus to test WARMUP_RATIO=0.01 for better synergy with the lower LR.
parsed.description: Testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.01 on the current best configuration (MATRIX_LR=0.03, WD=0.1) to see if shorter warmup improves convergence.
